questions.question: What is the sum of the first 12 terms of an arithmetic progression if the first term is 3 and last term is 47?
questions.solution:
The sum of ‘n’ terms of an A.P. is given as,

Sum = (n/2) × (first term + last term)

Given, n = 12

First term = 3

Last term = 47

∴ Sum of 12 terms of A.P. = (12/2) × (3 + 47) = 6 × 50 = 300

questions.question: If the selling price of an item is Rs 1000 after getting a discount of 20%, then what was the marked price (in Rs)?
questions.solution:
Selling price = Marked price - discount price

⇒ 1000 = MP - 20% of MP

⇒ 1000 = MP - 0.2MP

⇒ 0.8MP = 1000

⇒ MP = 1000/0.8 = 1250

∴ Marked price of item = Rs. 1250

questions.question: What is the slope of the line 2x + 3y = 12?
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

2x + 3y = 12

**Concept used:-**

For a line equation, y = mx + c

Where, m = Slope of a line

**Calculation:-** 

A line with slope ‘m’ is represented as, y = mx + c

⇒ 2x + 3y = 12

⇒ 3y = -2x + 12

⇒ y = (-2/3)x + 4

∴ **The slope of the given line is -2/3**

questions.question: The areas of two similar triangles ΔXYZ and ΔPQR are 100 sq cms and 25 sq cms respectively. If PQ = 4 cm then what is the length of XY (in cm)?
questions.solution:
The ratio of the area of similar triangles is equal to the square of ratio of their corresponding sides,

Hence, for similar triangles ΔXYZ and ΔPQR,

⇒ area(ΔXYZ)/area(ΔPQR) = (XY/PQ)²

⇒ 100/25 = (XY/4)²

⇒ 10/5 = XY/4

⇒ XY = (10 × 4)/5 = 8 cm

∴ Length of XY = 8 cm

questions.question: If a taxi going at 40 km/hr takes 25 minutes to travel a certain distance, by how much should it increase its speed (in km/hr) to travel the same distance in 20 minutes?
questions.solution:
When the speed is 40 km/hr, time taken = 25 min. = 25/60 = (5/12) hrs.

Distance travelled = Speed × Time = 40 × (5/12) = (50/3) km

To cover the distance in 20 min.,

Speed of taxi should be = (50/3)/(20/60) = 50 km/hr

∴ The speed should be increased by = 50 - 40 = 10 km/hr.

sec 30° + tan 60°

questions.question: What is the area (in sq cm) of a rectangle of perimeter 48 cm and breadth 10 cm?
questions.solution:
Perimeter of a rectangle = 2(length + breadth)

⇒ 48 = 2(length + 10)

⇒ 24 = length + 10

⇒ Length = 24 - 10 = 14 cm

∴ Area of rectangle = length × breadth = 14 × 10 = 140 cm²

questions.question: Δ PQR is right angled at Q. If ∠R = 30°, then what is the value of Cot P?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In ∆PQR, ∠Q = 90° and ∠R = 30°

**Concept used:**

Sum of angles of a triangle = 180°

**Calculation:**

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q + ∠R = 180°

⇒ 30° + 90° + ∠P = 180°

⇒ ∠P = 180° - 120° = 60°

⇒ cot P = cot 60° = 1/√3

**∴ Cot P = 1/√3**

questions.question: If A and B together do a job in 7.5 days and if A could do the job in 10 days if he worked alone. How many days would B take to do the job if he worked alone?
questions.solution:
A’s 1 day work + B’s 1 day work = 1/7.5 = 2/15

A’s 1 day work = 1/10

B’s 1 day work = 2/15 - 1/10 = 1/30

∴ B will do the job in 30 days if he worked alone

questions.question: What is the largest 4 digit number which is exactly divisible by 81?
questions.solution:
The largest 4 digit number is 9999

When 9999 is divided by 81, a remainder of 36 is obtained

∴ The largest 4 digit number exactly divisible by 81 = 9999 - 36 = 9963

questions.question: If a vendor sells a coconut at Rs. 24 he makes 20% loss. If he sells at Rs. 36 then what is his profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price of a coconut is Rs. ‘x’

Cost price - loss = selling price

⇒ x - 20% of x = 24

⇒ x - 0.2x = 24

⇒ 0.8x = 24

⇒ x = 24/0.8 = Rs. 30

Cost price of a coconut = Rs. 30

When the selling price is Rs. 36,

∴ Profit % = [(36 - 30)/30] × 100 = 20%

questions.question: The average cost of 4 items in a shopping list is Rs. 1,250. If one more item whose cost is Rs 2,000 is added to the list what will be the new average (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
Total cost of 4 items = 4 × 1250 = Rs. 5000

Total cost of 5 items = 5000 + 2000 = Rs. 7000

∴ New average = 7000/5 = Rs. 1400

questions.question: If compound interest received on a certain amount in the 3rd year is Rs. 1,240, what will be the compound interest (in Rs) for the 4th year on the same amount at 9% rate of interest?
questions.solution:
Compound interest for 4th year = Compound interest in 3rd year × (1 + R/100)

Compound interest in 3rd year = Rs. 1240

R = 9%

∴ Compound interest for 4th year = 1240 × (1 + 9/100) = Rs. 1351.6

questions.question: If Sec θ = 5/3, then what is the value of Cosec θ?
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

Secθ = 5/3

**Formula used:-**

Using trigonometric identities,

sec²θ = 1 + tan²θ

cosec2θ = 1 + cot2θ

**Calculation:-**

From identities - 

⇒ tan²θ = 25/9 - 1

= 16/9

∴ cot²θ = 9/16

Also,

⇒ cosec²θ = 1 + cot²θ

= 1 + 9/16 = 25/16

⇒ cosec²θ = 25/16

∴ cosecθ = √(25/16)

= 5/4

cosecθ = 1.25

∴ **The required value of cosecθ = 1.25. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] 

__Shortcut Trick__**

**Calculation:-**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a020c9fbc441c46523746380a2334162aa99bb205a423c19ba57184e2076f2d.png] 

secθ = 5/3 = Hypotenuse/Adjacent

From Shree Dharacharya Formula -

Hypotenuse² = Opposite² + Adjacent²

∴ Opposite = √(5² - 3²)

Opposite = 4

∴ cosecθ = Hypotenuse/Opposite

= 5/4 = 1.25

∴ **The required value of cosecθ is 1.25.**

questions.question: If a - b = 2 and ab = 8, then what is the value of (a³ - b³)?
questions.solution:
As we know, (a - b)³ = (a³ - b³) - 3ab(a - b)

⇒ (a³ - b³) = (a - b)³ + 3ab(a - b)

⇒ (2)³ + 3(8)(2)

⇒ 8 + 48

⇒ 56
